{
  "thinking": "Blank table and a 10-minute clock. I'll take the pad and sketch a fish: its tail, dorsal fin and body outline should read clearly from the fallen shape. Then I'll lay it out.",
  "say": "Right, I've got the pad. I'm going to draw a fish: tail on the left, a fin on top, and a nice curved body. I'll start from the top of the tail, so you can see where the line runs.",
  "to": "everyone",
  "eagerness": 7,
  "point": [3, 6],
  "pad": "take",
  "sketch_clear": true,
  "sketch": [
    {"type": "curve", "points": [[3, 6], [8, 10], [12, 7], [18, 7], [22, 10]]},
    {"type": "curve", "points": [[22, 10], [18, 13], [12, 13], [8, 10], [3, 14]]},
    {"type": "line", "x0": 3, "y0": 6, "x1": 3, "y1": 14},
    {"type": "curve", "points": [[12, 7], [14, 4], [17, 7]]},
    {"type": "label", "x": 3, "y": 6, "text": "START"}
  ],
  "do": "stop",
  "notes": "Plan: fish facing right. Stroke 1 = top edge from tail-top START to nose. Stroke 2 = bottom edge back from nose to tail-bottom. Stroke 3 = tail closing line. Stroke 4 = dorsal fin off the top edge. Trace stroke 1 first with start:true; others branch off it. Keep the start domino's line clear of the tail closing line."
}
